clean_task.detail: The official PTS 10.8.3 CLI ran pinned c-ray-2.0.0 twice in a digest-pinned SIF with application networking disabled; whole-run averages differed by 0.575 percent and no imported attachment executed.

provider_portability.detail: Provider independence was established by withdrawing the incumbent ari.provider.coding and re-offering the identical capability contracts under the reserved stand-in identity ari.provider.synthetic-substitute. All 4 capabilities the incumbent had won rebound, deterministically, and none stayed bound to the incumbent. No second implementation was executed, so this is not cross-Provider portability: it shows only that the requirement set names capabilities rather than a Provider. The report is stored beside this file as evidence/intel_phoronix_test_suite.abstraction.json.
